pages.title: Quagga
pages.text: The quagga ($(o)Equus quagga quagga$()) is an extinct subspecies of the plains zebra that lived on the grasslands of the Karoo and southern Free State of South Africa.$(br2)It was striped only on the head, neck and forequarters, fading to a plain brown on the rear of its body.$(br2)Hunted heavily by settlers, it vanished in the wild in the 1870s, and the last known quagga died at Amsterdam Zoo in 1883.
